content.title: Kimberly-Clark to Buy Tylenol Maker Kenvue. Why the Stock Market Hates the Deal.
content.summary: Kimberly-Clark  is buying Tylenol maker  Kenvue  for nearly $50 billion.  The cash-and-stock transaction, announced Monday, values Kenvue at an enterprise value of about $48.7 billion, including debt.  Under the terms of the deal, Kenvue shareholders will receive $21.01 a share, based on Kenvue’s closing price of $14.37 on Friday.
